items.title: 18.8.2 Sex Linked Disorders in Humans (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of sex-linked disorders, block for block; the book's problem is a self-check with a drawn Punnett square (PDF 108-110).

blocks.text: Haemophilia aik kam milne wali X-linked recessive khasiyat (bimari) hai. Is bimari mein chot lagne ke baad khoon theek se nahi jamta (clot nahi hota). Is ki wajah khoon jamane wale factors (clotting factors) ka kam hona, theek kaam na karna ya maujood hi na hona hai. Haemophilia ki teen qismein hain: A, B aur C.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat)
blocks.text: Mardon ke Y chromosome par aik khaas gene hai jise SRY (Sex-determining Region Y) kehte hain. Yeh aik protein banata hai jo testes (khusiye) ki nashonuma shuru karta hai aur maada ke tolidi dhaanchon (female reproductive structures) ki nashonuma rokta hai.
Haemophilia A aur B khoon jamane wale factors VIII aur IX ki kharabi se hoti hain. Yeh dono X-linked recessive hain, is liye mardon mein auraton se zyada hoti hain.
Haemophilia C khoon jamane wale factor XI ki kharabi se hoti hai. Yeh autosomal recessive hai, is liye mardon aur auraton dono mein barabar hoti hai.

blocks.caption: Haemophilia ki qismein
rows: Autosomal recessive; dono jinson mein barabar

blocks.prompt: Do normal walidain ka bachcha haemophiliac hai. Walidain ke genotypes kya ho sakte hain? Cross ka Punnett square banayein.
blocks.explanation: Maa carrier XᴴXʰ aur baap normal XᴴY. Punnett square ke chaar bachche: XᴴXᴴ (normal beti), XᴴY (normal beta), XᴴXʰ (carrier beti) aur XʰY (haemophiliac beta). Is liye haemophiliac bachcha beta hai (XʰY), aur us ka Xʰ maa se aaya. Normal baap (XᴴY) ki koi beti haemophiliac nahi ho sakti, kyunke har beti ko baap ka Xᴴ milta hai.

answer_figure.alt: Punnett square: carrier maa (XᴴXʰ) ke gametes Xᴴ aur Xʰ baen taraf, normal baap (XᴴY) ke gametes Xᴴ aur Y oopar. Khane: XᴴXᴴ normal beti, XᴴY normal beta, XᴴXʰ carrier beti, XʰY haemophiliac beta.
answer_figure.caption: Jawab ka diagram (pehle khud banayein, phir milayein): carrier maa (XᴴXʰ) × normal baap (XᴴY) ka Punnett square
answer_figure.long_description: Oopar 'Mother: carrier (XᴴXʰ) × Father: normal (XᴴY)'. Grid ke oopar baap ke gametes Xᴴ aur Y, baen taraf maa ke gametes Xᴴ aur Xʰ. Pehli qatar: XᴴXᴴ (Normal daughter), XᴴY (Normal son), hare rang mein. Doosri qatar: XᴴXʰ (Carrier daughter) naranji rang mein, XʰY (Haemophiliac son) gulabi rang mein. Neeche: haemophiliac bachcha XʰY beta (bachchon ka 1/4); walidain: maa XᴴXʰ, baap XᴴY.

blocks.title: Khoon jamne ka normal tareeqa (Coagulation)
blocks.text:
Khoon jamna aik pecheeda amal hai jo chot lagne par zyada khoon behne se bachata hai. Is ke marahil yeh hain:
1. Chot lagne par platelets chot ki jagah chipak kar platelet plug banate hain.
2. Activated (fa'al) platelets aur zakhmi tissue clotting factors chhorte hain.
3. Clotting factors chemical reactions ka silsila (clotting cascade) chalate hain, jis mein ghulne wala (soluble) protein fibrinogen na ghulne wale (insoluble) protein fibrin mein badal jata hai.
4. Fibrin jaal jaisa dhaancha banata hai jo khoon ke hisson ko phansa kar thos lothra (clot) bana deta hai.
5. Fibrin ke dhagon ke aapas mein jurne (cross-linking) se clot mazboot ho jata hai.
Agar khoon jamne ke nizam ka tawazun bigar jaye to khoon ghair maamooli tareeqe se jamne lagta hai; ise thrombosis kehte hain. Is se stroke aur heart attack (dil ka daura) jaise sangeen masail ho sakte hain.
